stock.description: China Hongguang Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of architectural glass solutions throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's offerings include a range of safety glass products, such as coated, insulating, laminated, and tempered glass, alongside advanced smart glass technology like dimming glass, all marketed under the Hongguang brand. This firm was established in 1992 and its main corporate office is located in Jieyang, PRC.
